terms.comment: The classical verb (Cic., Hor.). In the example Erasmus borrows Horace’s child riding a hobby-horse (S. 2.3.248).

phrases.latin: Sed quibus decōrum est lūdere nucibus, iīsdem nōn indecōrum equitāre in arundine longā.
phrases.english: Those for whom it is proper to play with nuts may decently ride a hobby-horse too.

sources: Lewis & Short: equitatio · Lewis & Short: equito
Erasmus from the Latinitas loci collection (loci-erasmus).
